nodes.label: Write Get Started Icon
nodes.description: A 56x56 SVG icon depicting a pen/pencil writing tool combined with a plus/cross symbol, rendered in the primary brand orange color (#EE4723). The main diagonal stroke represents a writing/editing action, while the cross/plus symbols at corners suggest adding or getting started with content creation. Used to represent 'write' or 'get started' call-to-action, likely for onboarding or content creation entry points. Also includes a horizontal underline bar element suggesting document writing.
